postal_system.scope: UPU September 2025 no-postcode-required classification for Syria; this does not create an AGID code or prove a delivery area.

identifier_namespaces.rule: An explicit operator record may identify an office or P.O. box, but it is not a postcode or surrounding postal polygon.
Source-qualified governorate, district and locality context retains the exact source edition and geometry authority.
House, street, premise and building fields require explicit permitted source records and relations; no containment or proximity promotion.
Independent spatial index from reviewed geometry; never represented as a Syrian Post code or official postal area.

stages.definition: No-postcode address-format inventory and synthetic planning pack only.
Reviewed no-postcode, operator, rights, privacy and authority contract with exact reference receipts.

A current, rights-cleared real Syrian postal-office/delivery-context, civic-address or administrative/locality dataset with explicit declared coverage, stable source row identity, Arabic source fields, acquisition time, edition, validity semantics, schema and SHA-256 reproducibly produces approved immutable digest-pinned artifacts and passes the actual SY AGID loader/API. Local postalCode remains null and official postal geometry remains none unless an independent current authority publishes explicit postal geometry. Administrative boundaries, office points, P.O. boxes, routes, AGID cells and learned or generated regions keep separate authority and cannot become official postal polygons. House numbers and buildings require explicit permitted source records and relations; conflict-sensitive precision, personal, recipient, owner, occupant and land-rights data stay excluded. Synthetic tests, policy pages, inaccessible sites and source metadata alone never establish M2.

agid_integration.current_scope: SY address metadata and synthetic Postal Forge planning pack only; generic Postal Context data runtime remains disabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A licensed no-postcode address-context descriptor, approved immutable real-data artifacts and actual SY loader/API verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture an official postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, civic or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified; derived and virtual regions require explicit separate provenance.
